source.version: Part 15 — Arthropod and Invertebrate Pests — Batch 01
source.publicationAuthorization: Project owner authorized continued website publication on 2026-08-31. Independent specialist approval remains a separate project-control field and is not implied by publication.
source.releaseTimeReview: THC-ENC-281–285 were reconciled against the controlled Part 15 catalogue plus peer-reviewed hemp pest reviews, direct hemp-russet-mite biology and molecular-detection research, and current university-extension identification guidance for spider mites, russet mites, broad mites, and thrips. Public wording separates injury from species identity, preserves specimen/magnification and cross-species evidence limits, rejects universal cannabis or hemp action thresholds where they are not established, and keeps pesticide or regulated-product use governed by current labels, registrations, safety requirements, residue rules, and jurisdiction.
source.note: This batch opens controlled Volume 15 with pest-identification reasoning, two-spotted spider mites, hemp russet mites, broad mites, and western flower thrips/related thrips.
